description: Per account scope, collapse fee records to one net rate per order (averaging within the order), then average across orders and count orders.

c.request: For each account scope, using fees tied to orders (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`) and to the users who placed them (`orders.userlink` = `users.userstamp`), with unmatched rows dropped, show the scope, the average net fee rate (fee rate minus maker rebate rate), how many it was averaged over, and how far that average sits from the simple mean of the scope averages. Don't round. Per account scope, collapse fee records to one net rate per order (averaging within the order), then average across orders and count orders.
c.sql: WITH fee_order_user AS (SELECT u.acctscope, o.recordvault, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net_fee_rate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp), order_level_net AS (SELECT acctscope, recordvault, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_rate_per_order FROM fee_order_user GROUP BY acctscope, recordvault), scope_level AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(avg_net_rate_per_order) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS order_count FROM order_level_net GROUP BY acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_of_averages FROM scope_level) SELECT sl.acctscope, sl.avg_net_fee_rate, sl.order_count, sl.avg_net_fee_rate - om.mean_of_averages AS deviation_from_mean FROM scope_level sl CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY sl.acctscope;

a.request: For each account scope (`users.acctscope`), taking fee records linked to their order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`) and that order's user (`orders.userlink` = `users.userstamp`), and dropping any without a match, show the scope, the average net fee rate (`feerate` minus `rebrate`) taken over orders, where each order's net rate is its average `feerate` minus its average `rebrate` across its fee records (ignoring orders where it is missing), the number of orders, and how far the scope's average net rate is above or below the plain average of the per-scope averages. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH order_net_rates AS (SELECT o.recordvault, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY o.recordvault, u.acctscope), scope_stats AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS scope_avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_net_rates GROUP BY acctscope), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(scope_avg_net_rate) AS overall_average FROM scope_stats) SELECT s.acctscope, s.scope_avg_net_rate, s.order_count, s.scope_avg_net_rate - oa.overall_average AS difference_from_overall FROM scope_stats s CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY s.acctscope

d.request: For each account scope, aggregate fees within each order by averaging their net rates (feerate - rebrate) to get one net rate per order, then average those per-order rates across orders in the scope, count the orders, and calculate the deviation of each scope's average from the overall mean of all scope averages.
d.sql:
WITH fees_with_net_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    o.recordvault,
    u.acctscope,
    (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net_rate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
per_order_net_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    recordvault,
    acctscope,
    AVG(net_rate) AS order_net_rate
  FROM fees_with_net_rate
  GROUP BY recordvault, acctscope
),
scope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    AVG(order_net_rate) AS scope_avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM per_order_net_rate
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(scope_avg_net_rate) AS mean_of_averages
  FROM scope_averages
)
SELECT 
  s.acctscope,
  s.scope_avg_net_rate,
  s.order_count,
  (s.scope_avg_net_rate - o.mean_of_averages) AS deviation
FROM scope_averages s
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
ORDER BY s.acctscope

b.request: For each account scope, average all fee net rates directly per scope, count fee records, and show absolute distance from the grand mean of scope averages.
b.sql:
WITH fee_with_scope AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net_rate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
scope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_count
  FROM fee_with_scope
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
grand_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS mean_of_averages
  FROM scope_stats
)
SELECT 
  s.acctscope,
  s.avg_net_rate,
  s.fee_count,
  ABS(s.avg_net_rate - g.mean_of_averages) AS distance_from_grand_mean
FROM scope_stats s
CROSS JOIN grand_mean g
ORDER BY s.acctscope
